title: File:Painting of the governor of Nan At Phumin Temple.jpg
author: Painting: Nan Bua Phan (death date unknown).[1][2]
description: Painting on the eastern pillar of the wall of Wat Phumin in Nan, Thailand, believed to be Chao Anantaworaritthidet, the governor of Nan at the time, but may also be King Suriyaphongpharitdet.
